en: We're here.
So where's the anomaly?
Um... let me see...
This is a bit of a problem. It's inside the mine that was wrecked in the big explosion. You need a pass to get in.
Then go get one issued.
Come on... I'm traveling as a commoner.
Fine. Let's go take a look first, then.
Who makes these mazes, anyway? They're always in such annoying places. Last time it was under the Magic Something, now it's an abandoned mine... Oh, I know. We'll just sneak in.
That won't work. The St. Melo Keep mine has only one way in or out, and it's guarded all day long. You can't get in without a pass.
So you two want a Silverleaf pass? Maybe I can help you out~
The two heroes turn around at once.
A little boy who looks only twelve or thirteen.
Why don't we go check the Silverleaf city office?
The two turn back around.
Hey! I'm serious!
Let's rest at the inn first and think about it...
The two turn and walk off.
Then take a look at THIS!!
The boy pulls out a sheet of paper and waves it hard in front of them.
A special pass for Silverleaf!
The two stop, and turn around again.
Your lost sister? That's your price?
Yep. Find her, and this is yours.
The boy waves the paper in his hand.
That's it?
And it has to be today.
OK, deal.
Deal, my foot!! You don't know what his sister looks like or how long she's been missing, and you're going to find her in one day?!
Don't worry about that. Here's her picture.
The boy hands Eluna a locket.
Ohhh~~ She's really pretty.
Eluna opens the lid and studies it as she talks.
And I pretty much know where she is, too.
Where?
She's the leader of the Moon of Vengeance's Silverleaf branch.
The Moon of Vengeance: an armed, terrorist-like group in Okaros out to overthrow the current regime.
It mostly attacks soldiers and officials, and is the most dangerous group in Okaros.
The leader? Great, it's a deal. Let's go right now.
Hey... you could at least ask what I think!! That's the Moon of Vengeance!! If they see us we're dead, and you want to meet their leader?! Huh? Wait...
Delat compares Eluna with the terrorists, again and again.
Fine. (I feel a bit safer -_-~~)
Relax. As long as they don't see us, we're fine. A gang like that must have more than one way in.
About that, I know a secret tunnel that goes in. It's just outside the city, really close.
So all you want is for us to help you see her? OK, let's go right now!
So there really is a tunnel... Wasn't the Moon of Vengeance founded only ten years ago? And there's a secret passage even they don't know about?
It was obviously built for something else before. Never mind that, let's finish what we came for. Are we there yet?
That exit up ahead is it.
The Moon of Vengeance is out and about again. What a pain. I'll have to be careful going outside the city from now on.
Did you want something?
N-no.
Oh, good.
Why do you keep staring at me? There's nothing on my face.
The gate is locked tight.
This is the mine. No entry without a pass.
I really can't go in?
Of course not. What are you up to?
Hey, why don't we head back to town and look around first?
Hmph! Fine.
I have a pass.
Oh? Let me see it...
Sorry, this pass has expired.
What? You're kidding, right? Expired?
Yes. Silverleaf passes have a time limit, and this one ran out just last month.
...That kid conned us...
Never mind. As long as he gets to see his sister. Oh, right, the city office should be able to issue a pass, shouldn't it? Let's go check, quick.
Oh? Let me see it.
Let's see...
Mm, that's right, this is a pass. All right, go on in.
Going in?
Not now.
OK, here's what you wanted.
That's all it takes?
I also need you to do me a favor.
And that is... MOON OF VENGEANCE, YOU BIG IDIOTS!!!! COME OUT HERE!!!
Wh-what are you doing?!
All you have to do is lure the Moon people away for me~~~ OK, here they come, I'm gonna go hide now~
Hey!!
Haaah... No wonder they're the most dangerous group around... So many of them... and summoned beasts, too...
Well, we're fine, that's what matters. Now hurry up to the mine.
Hey! We've been running all this time and we don't even get a break...
Hurry up! At this rate you won't reach the beautiful surface even in your next life. (Not even out of breath.)
I'm very busy right now. Do not disturb.
Um, I'd like to know how to get a pass for the mine.
For the mine? Let me see...
Hm, that needs a special permit from the palace.
There's no other way?
No.
Looks like we'll just have to come back tonight and help ourselves to one.
Y-you can't be serious. This again?
The two walk out of the city office.
Sigh...
Hey! Look at this wanted poster!
Isn't this the guy we beat last time?
Let me see? Whoa! It's Leoz, one of the Moon of Vengeance's top leaders. So that means...
Delat grabs Eluna's right hand and looks at the ring on it.
This is all we need.
They come out of the city office once again.
Delat grabs Eluna's right hand once again.
Lucky right hand.
You're way too lucky! Leoz guards that ring like his life, and it's worth a bounty. It falls off in a fight and you pick it up! Then the city office takes it for a pass instead of the reward!
Of course they agreed. Who wouldn't want to save a pile of money? But one thing's strange. Why did that guy lose to us? He's supposed to be "invincible".
True... Oh well, no use thinking about it now. Let's go get some sleep first.
Sleep? You're leaving right now!
Waaah! ...Let go of me!! You woman with a screw loose!!!!
Enough talk. Get to the mine, now!!!
Good, that makes two. On to the next city, then.
Tomorrow? Can it be tomorrow?
No!
Ah... excuse me. Are you the ones Heath bothered today?
The two turn around: a man of about thirty.
Heath?
The kid with the special pass.
Oh. Then yes, that's us.
I'm his doctor and his guardian. He's back now, and he says he wants to see you.
His doctor?
I'm sorry, I lied to you. I don't really have a sister.
No... I mean... she's already dead...
I already knew.
That makes Delat and Heath both stare at Eluna.
The date in your locket is from last year, but you said you'd been separated from your sister for eight years.
But...
And the spot on your right ear. That's Dorowell Syndrome. You look perfectly normal, but you don't have long to live.
I... I... I really did have a sister, but she died eight years ago. I watched them bury her. She was the only family I had. I know she's never coming back, but I... I...
So that leader looks a lot like your sister?
Yes. I just wanted to see her once. I'm sorry! I didn't think there'd be so many of them! I thought there'd only be a few!
What about the locket and the pass?
I just found them by chance. I... I'm sorry!!
It's OK. I understand. I've been there myself. Oh, right, Doctor?
Yes?
How long does he have?
...Until tomorrow.
...All right. Then you'll get one day with your sister. Doctor, find me a few herbs. I want to try a recipe from an old book for changing your face.
I think he was really happy at the end.
...When you sang him the lullaby at the end, he was crying so hard, but he was smiling...
I hope he's happy up there... OK. We've got our own job to do, too.
By the way, if that potion works so well, why don't you use it? Like, disguise yourself as a Silverleaf office clerk and walk right into the mine?
Idiot!! That stuff really hurts on your face! It hurts worse than a knife cut!! Want me to cut you a few times so you can compare?
This side of the city is newly built, so it's different from the other side.
Stairs... stairs... hmm... stairs.
A few years ago there was a huge explosion in Silverleaf's old mine, so they sealed it off.
Nobody knows what caused it...
Dig here.
Digging here is strictly forbidden.
Set Starstone
There's nothing near the stone.
Fit Cogwheel
New heroes?? Come, then. Let me see your strength.
Very well. Take the key.
I don't have much. Take a look.
You're not on "Special", huh? If you were on "Special", I could teach you a thing or two.
Ah, you're on "Special"? Want me to teach you a couple of moves?
Yes please
No thanks
I can teach you two moves. Which one do you want to learn?
Skill Lock
Revive
You already know that one.
I've got nothing left to teach you.
There's a really nasty guy outside the city. Get rid of him for me, will you?
You're not strong enough yet. Come back later.
Not bad. Take this.
I've got an apple here. I'll sell it to you for 5000 Gold.
OK, here you go.
You don't even have the money, and you want to buy something?!
Haaah... Maybe I'll take a walk outside the city later.
Ahh~~ I really want an apple...
Got one?
Mm! Delicious...
I found this on the road. You can have it.
You don't have one at all... Sigh...
I'm full. Time to find something else to do.
Hmm... If you give me another apple... I could teach you something.
Watch closely! The secret art of the Whirlwind school...
Don't underestimate me. I'm pretty strong, too!
